⚠️ रोहित शेट्टी के नाम पर हो रहा है बड़ा खेल, मामला जानकर रह जाएंगे हैरान! 😱

फिल्ममेकर रोहित शेट्टी ने हाल ही में साफ किया है कि उनका फेसबुक और एक्स पर कोई अकाउंट नहीं है। 📱

उनका कहना है कि इंस्टाग्राम ही उनका एकमात्र ऑफिशियल सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म है। 💯

असली बवाल तब मचा जब इंटरनेट पर एक फर्जी फेसबुक पोस्ट वायरल हुई, जिसमें comedian Gaurav Gupta के Bigg Boss 20 के contestants Scout OP और Love Gill पर किए गए roast पर टिप्पणी की गई थी। 🎭

वायरल पोस्ट में लिखा था कि रोस्टिंग के नाम पर किसी का मजाक उड़ाना बंद होना चाहिए और किसी को insult करके हंसाना ठीक नहीं है। 🛑

लोग इसे रोहित का बयान मान बैठे, जिसके बाद उन्होंने फैंस से ऐसे फर्जी प्रोफाइल्स से दूर रहने की अपील की है। 🙏

रोहित इन दिनों अपनी आने वाली फिल्म Golmaal 5 की तैयारी में जुटे हैं, जो 8 जनवरी 2027 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी। 🎬

क्या आपको लगता है कि सोशल मीडिया पर सेलेब्स के नाम से बनने वाले फेक अकाउंट्स पर कड़ा एक्शन होना चाहिए? 💬

ctx.title: Rohit Shetty warns fans against fake Facebook, X accounts after post on Gaurav Gupta's Bigg Boss 20 roast circulates online
ctx.summary: Rohit Shetty clarified that Instagram is his only official social media platform after a Facebook post attributed to him circulated online.
ctx.text:
Filmmaker Rohit Shetty has issued a clarification after a Facebook post attributed to him began circulating online, leading many to believe that he had commented on comedian Gaurav Gupta's roast of Bigg Boss 20 contestants Scout OP and Love Gill. The filmmaker has clarified that he is not on Facebook or X and that Instagram is his only official social media platform.
Rohit took to Instagram to warn fans against fake accounts impersonating him on other platforms. He urged people not to engage with such profiles or consider the content shared through them as his own.
In his statement, he wrote, "I would like to clarify that my only official social media presence is on Instagram. I am not present on Facebook or X. Any account or profile claiming to be me on these platforms is fake and unauthorised. I request everyone to not engage with such accounts or consider any content posted through them as coming from me. Thank you for your understanding and continued support."
The clarification came after a Facebook post, seemingly discussing Gaurav Gupta's roast of Bigg Boss 20 contestants Scout OP and Love Gill, began circulating online. The post read, "Friendly roasting theek hai par roasting ke naam par kisi ka mazaak udaana band hona chahiye. Hansana achhi baat hai, lekin kisi ko rulakar ya insult karke hansna nahi. Respect everyone (Friendly roasting is fine, but making fun of someone under the guise of 'roasting' needs to stop. It’s good to make people laugh, but not at the expense of making someone cry or by insulting them)."
Many social media users believed the post was written by Rohit, prompting the filmmaker to set the record straight.
Recently, comedian Gaurav Gupta appeared on the Diwali-special episode of Bigg Boss 20, hosted by Salman Khan. During the episode, he took playful digs at several contestants, including Scout OP(real name Tanmay Singh) and Love Gill. However, some of his jokes, particularly those concerning their personal lives and relationships, did not go down well with the contestants.
Rohit Shetty is gearing up for Golmaal 5, the fifth instalment of his popular comedy franchise. The film stars Ajay Devgn, Arshad Warsi, Tusshar Kapoor, Shreyas Talpade, Kunal Kemmu and Sharman Joshi, with Akshay Kumar joining the franchise. The filmmaker has announced January 8, 2027, as its theatrical release date. The film marks the return of the Golmaal gang nearly a decade after Golmaal Again (2017).
